dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Please take note of the following before entering the hot springs."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "First, pick the right pool, and watch the water temperature, or you might get scalded. Travelers from abroad should get acclimated to an artificial pool first before trying any natural ones!"

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Next up, no playing around in the hot springs. Not only will this disturb others, but you might also slip and fall."

dialogues.speaker: Hot Spring Notice
dialogues.text: "Last of all, know your limits. Don't be afraid to step out should you feel uncomfortable, and don't forget to drink water and eat some food to keep your stamina up."
